description: Search 200M+ academic papers on Semantic Scholar by keyword or exact title. Returns titles, authors, year, venue, CITATION COUNTS, DOI, and open-access PDF links. PREFER for "how many citations does <paper title> have", "citation count for <paper>", "how cited is <paper>" — search the title and read citationCount off the match. Optionally filter by year range and field of study. Keyless.

fields_of_study.description: Filter by field of study, e.g. "Computer Science", "Medicine", "Biology", "Physics".

query.description: Search query, e.g. "transformer attention mechanism" or "CRISPR gene editing".

year.description: Filter by publication year or range, e.g. "2023" or "2020-2024".

name: search_papers
